fee_notes: Royalty Fee is the greater of 7% of Gross Sales or $2,500/month. Brand Fund is up to 2% of Gross Sales or $200/month, whichever is higher; contributions began in fiscal year 2022. Marketing Fee is a separate flat $2,500/month for local advertising (not a % of Gross Sales); Co-op contributions credited dollar-for-dollar against Marketing Fee. Technology Service Fee is currently $500/month, subject to increase upon 30 days notice limited to actual cost increases plus up to 5% overhead. Additional notable fees include: Non-Compliance Fee (up to $2,000/violation), Head Trainer Induction ($600), Promotional Programs (up to monthly royalty fee amount if Gross Sales fall below 70% of system average), Merchandise for Resale (min $1,500 per quarter), LionHeart Bands ($54/monitor, min 100/year after first year), Additional Training ($250-$500/day/person), On-site Evaluation ($160-$320 plus $250/day per diem), Annual Conference ($600/ticket, min 2 tickets), Transfer Fee (25% of then-current establishment fee plus costs), Renewal Fee (greater of $5,000 or 10% of then-current Establishment Fee), Secret Shopper Fee ($250/studio/year, max $50/year increase).
raw_excerpt:
Royalty Fee: The greater of 7% of Gross Sales or $2,500 per month. $2,500 is due on the Opening Date and then in advance on the first day of each calendar month thereafter. Any additional Royalty Fee is due on the fifteenth day of the following calendar month based on the services provided and Gross Sales received in the prior month.
Brand Fund: Up to 2% of Gross Sales, or $200 per month, whichever is higher. Payable monthly on the first day of each month for the prior month.
Marketing Fee: $2,500 per month. On the Opening Date of your Studio and in advance on the first day of each subsequent calendar month.
Technology Service Fee: Currently, $500 per month. Beginning the month you first begin using the Services and in advance on the first day of each calendar month thereafter. We reserve the right to increase this fee at any time, upon 30 days' written notice; however, any increase will be limited to the increase in our actual costs and expenses related to the provision of the Technology Service Fee plus up to a 5% increase for any overhead and administrative expenses.
